outcome: negative impact upon quality of life (QoL)
cohort: The study included 522 pregnant women with gestational UI, consisting of 155 with gestational hypothyroidism (HUI group) and 367 with euthyroidism (EUI group).
finding: Gestational hypothyroidism was associated with significantly greater leakage frequency, leakage amount, leakage severity, and negative impact on incontinence-specific QoL during pregnancy, 6-7 weeks postpartum, and over the first year postpartum, compared to euthyroidism.
